statements.q5_default_applied: The Q5 default classification of CC-219 Ruling 6 (prereg l.462-466) was applied to every status: published SFT data joinable by OI id is checkable (CLEAN-candidate, pending G-C2); an Open-Images-based SFT part whose split membership cannot be determined is UNCHECKABLE and treated as contaminated; web-scale pretraining is recorded as 'unknown' and disclosed; no CLEAN VI captioner or no CLEAN VI verifier on NoCaps test -> STOP.
statements.q5_redo_rule: If the PI's Q5 answer differs from CC-219 R6, this record is redone within the closed candidate list. The PI answered Q5 YES (= R6) in PI-1102a, so the default stands.
statements.validator: c_pvr.py gate-c1 does not exist yet (prereg l.747). This record must later pass `python3 scripts/c_pvr/c_pvr.py gate-c1 --record G_C1_record.json` byte-unchanged, or it gets a new read.
statements.status_basis: Every status follows only from the cited text. Unclear text -> UNCHECKABLE with the reason stated. Precedence when several facts apply: HIT > UNCHECKABLE > CLEAN-candidate. Fail-closed wording ('in part', 'such as', 'including', internal or unpublished data) -> UNCHECKABLE.
statements.quotes: Quotes are short provenance sentences in English only; no example caption, question or answer from any dataset is quoted.
statements.page_hashing: sha256 is computed with sha256sum on the exact bytes fetched by curl (no auth, no HF token, no e-mail in any request). Hub pages are fetched as raw README at a pinned commit (huggingface.co/<id>/raw/<commit>/README.md); the human-readable blob URL at the same commit is recorded. Copies saved as .session_backup/2026-11-02/g_c1_pages/<sha256>.<ext>. Live-page drift is non-fatal on its own; the status follows the access-stamped version (L2.2).

inclusion_criterion.written_before: any screening fetch and any status
inclusion_criterion.rule: A further VI captioner / VI verifier candidate is included iff ALL of: IC1 its weights are published on the Hugging Face hub; IC2 its own model card or technical report states Vietnamese as a supported or trained language; IC3 it is an instruction-following image+text -> free-text model (can caption and answer the FAIR 3-label prompt); IC4 its model card or technical report names its training/SFT data (dataset names or a released data mixture); IC5 total parameters <= 10B per its card or report (bf16 weights fit one 24 GB GPU); IC6 it is not one of the five named candidates or LLaVA-1.5-7B.
inclusion_criterion.enumeration: Pool fixed before screening = (E1) the 50 most-downloaded hub models from the no-auth query https://huggingface.co/api/models?pipeline_tag=image-text-to-text&language=vi&sort=downloads&direction=-1&limit=50 (response bytes saved and hashed); (E2) models named in the C direction documents v3/v4/v4.1 and not among the named candidates (InstructBLIP, set aside in v3 section 5.2 l.256); (E3) open multilingual VLMs with released instruction data known from the literature, listed before screening: neulab/Pangea-7B, WueNLP/centurio_qwen, WueNLP/centurio_aya, Gregor/mblip-mt0-xl, Gregor/mblip-bloomz-7b, google/paligemma2-10b-mix-448, allenai/Molmo-7B-D-0924, lmms-lab/llava-onevision-qwen2-7b-ov, HuggingFaceM4/Idefics3-8B-Llama3. Screening reads only model cards / reports for IC1-IC6, not SFT contents.
inclusion_criterion.order: Included further candidates follow the five named candidates in case-insensitive alphabetical order of hub id; this is 'the record's listed order' (prereg l.457). The list closes when G-C1 is committed; no candidate is added afterwards (L2.4).

ambiguities: A1 InternVL2.5 Table 4 (S05) is captioned "pre-training data mixture" but is curated conversation-format data, not web-scale; it was treated as a curated stage, so its OpenImages-Caption part counts as an OI-based part (affects Vintern-1B-v3_5 and InternVL3-8B; both are UNCHECKABLE on other grounds too).
A2 "OpenImages-Caption [116]" (S05) cites the OI v4 paper and names no split.

A3 Vintern: the Viet-OpenViVQA-gemini-VQA card (S27) is gated (401 without auth). The C direction v3 l.251 note of 2026-11-01 says it uses "8024 Vietnamese images in train split", but that page could not be re-read without auth, so it was not used. The report (S30) gives no split and calls its OpenViVQA-dev evaluation "zero-shot"; that is an assertion, not a data list. Status UNCHECKABLE, not HIT.

A4 Pangea NoCaps CLEAN-candidate: the read pages name no OI-based PangeaIns component, but they also do not state, per component, the image origin or whether OI ids are kept (ShareGPT4V, Cambrian737k, LLaVA-NeXt, ALLaVA/Vision-FLAN and others not traced). G-C2 must resolve this; an untraceable OI subset makes the row UNCHECKABLE.

A5 Pangea VI sets: Vietnamese image components of unstated origin (S28 gated; S29 gives no image source) -> UNCHECKABLE, read as the non-OI analogue of the Q5 undeterminable-split rule. A native-id join could resolve it, but none is registered.

A6 G-C2 is registered as an OI-id join only (prereg l.632-633). The mBLIP CLEAN-candidate rows on openvivqa_dev, vitextcaps_test and viecap4h_private_test rest on the documentation naming no Vietnamese-sourced image set; no registered join confirms them. For the coordinator/CC-222.

A7 Centurio: S22 Table 8 is captioned "in our analysis experiments"; the released checkpoints add "datasets from the Cambrian collection" (Appendix B.2 list not traced). The cards (S20, S21) say "Training Data: COMING SOON" at the pinned revisions.
A8 Aya-Vision-8B card (S10) and the 5CD-AI dataset cards (S27, S28, S31) return 401 without authentication; statuses rest on the reports and are fail-closed. The 401 bodies are hashed as fetched.

A9 mBLIP: the BLIP-2 Flan-T5-XL checkpoint used for initialisation (S15) is taken to carry the BLIP-2 pre-training data stated in S16 (COCO, VG + web). S16 does not separately document any fine-tuning of that exact checkpoint.

A10 LLaVA: the S24 README is pinned at GitHub main c121f04 (2024-05-11), which postdates the v1.5 checkpoint. S32 also lists TextCaps in the mixture; the README names only TextVQA train_val_images as the matching image download.

A11 Screening: the Qwen3.5 / Qwen3-VL cards were screened on the card for IC4 (no report naming VL training data is linked). IC5 for third-party GGUF/MLX repackagings used the base size in the repo name.

A13 mBLIP: S15 Appendix D.1 Table 6 confirms that the full training mix is Web CapFilt (CC3M+CC12M+SBU subset), MSCOCO, VQAv2, A-OKVQA, LLaVA detail/conversations and ImageNet/BabelImageNet. S14 says its folders also hold "the files of the tasks used to evaluate the model"; S15 evaluates on XM3600 (Open Images images). These are evaluation files, not training data, so they are not counted against the NoCaps row.

A14 InternVL3-8B: S33 (OpenGVLab/InternVL-Data) says the InternVL training dataset was withdrawn from public access. No released InternVL3 SFT id list was found. Only dataset cards were read; no data file was opened.
A12 "Web-scale" was read as uncurated web crawls (LAION, CC, SBU, CapFilt, encoder pretraining). Curated academic sets were never filed as "unknown".
